_note: A conveyance allowance for duties, exempt to the extent actually spent, where no free conveyance is provided (D-101; rulebook SAL-ALW-DUTY-001). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 Sch. III Table Sl. 12, "to the extent to which such expenses are actually incurred for that purpose"; Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.280(1)(d): "any allowance granted to meet the expenditure incurred on conveyance in performance of duties of an office or employment of profit where no free conveyance is provided by the employer"; in r.280(3)'s list, applied in the new regime per s.202(2)(a)(ii) — r.280(3) addresses "an option under section 202(4)", the opt-out (SAL-ALW-NEW-SUBSET-001); no official interpretation exists, and the owner rules this reading settled (D-216), so the version is SOURCE_CHECKED. TY 2025-26: 1961 s.10(14)(i) exempts allowances prescribed "to the extent to which such expenses are actually incurred"; Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.2BB(1)(c) with its proviso "free conveyance is not provided by the employer"; in r.2BB(3)'s list (G.S.R. 452(E)), so also for an assessee taxed under s.115BAC(1A). Entering the allowance is read as the employer providing no free conveyance.
